entities.name: Rudolf Henzi

entities.summary: Samuel Gottlieb Rudolph Henzi, was a Swiss linguist, professor at the University of Tartu on the chair of exegetics and Oriental languages, the dean of the theological faculty; head of the Tartu Branch of Russian Bible Society.
